events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 are held to a surprise 2–2 draw at 더비 카운티, with Malcolm Christie , a self-confessed United supporter, scoring both of 더비 카운티's goals.
월터 스미스 is sacked by 에버턴 after nearly four years as manager; they are reportedly interested in recruiting 데이비드 모예스 from 프레스턴 노스 엔드 as his successor.
데이비드 모예스 is appointed manager of 에버턴.

에버턴 beat 풀럼 2–1 at Goodison Park in their first match under the management of 데이비드 모예스. 리버풀 and 맨체스터 유나이티드 both win their games today to keep the title challenge fierce. In Division One, meanwhile, Stockport suffered the earliest post-war relegation by any other team after they lost 3-1 away to 윔블던.

A Football League First Division match between 셰필드 유나이티드 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 at Bramall Lane is abandoned in the 82nd minute with the scores 3-0 to 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, after 셰필드 유나이티드 go down to 6 men on the field, becoming the only match in English professional football history to be abandoned due to a shortage of players, in a match that would be known as the Battle of Bramall Lane .
아스널 continue to keep up the heat in the title challenge with a 2–1 win at 애스턴 빌라.
제라르 울리에 returns to 리버풀 after a six-month spell out. He watches his side defeat Roma in the Champions League .
맨체스터 유나이티드's title hopes are dented by a 1–0 home defeat by 미들즈브러.
리버풀 boost their title hopes when a last gasp goal by Vladimír Šmicer gives them a 1–0 home win over 첼시.
애스턴 빌라 sign 6' 7" striker 피터 크라우치 from 포츠머스 for £5million.

On the day of Queen Elizabeth The Queen Mother 's death, 맨체스터 유나이티드 remain firmly in the hunt for the Premier League title with a thrilling 4–3 win over 리즈 유나이티드 at Elland Road . However, 아스널 and 리버풀 both win their games, keeping the title challenge heated.

The Premier League title race remains in full swing as March draws to a close. 리버풀 are now top, 맨체스터 유나이티드 are second, and 아스널 are third, though 아스널 are two points off the top with two games in hand. The threat from the other top six clubs – 첼시, 리즈 유나이티드 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 – is now virtually non existent. Meanwhile, 레스터 시티's relegation is looking almost certain, while they and 더비 카운티 have been joined in the relegation zone by an 입스위치 타운 side whose resurgence in late winter appeared to have saved their Premier League status. 맨체스터 시티 lead the way in Division One, with 울버햄프턴 원더러스 still second but just three points ahead of nearest rivals 웨스트브로미치 앨비언. Just three points separate the next six teams – 번리, 밀월, 버밍엄 시티, 코번트리 시티, 프레스턴 노스 엔드 and 노리치 시티.
